name: report_statement
description: State the one thing a person must know to answer these tasks well.

verdict.description: stated when you can say it; unsure when you cannot tell what answering the tasks well requires

statement.description: The one thing, as one sentence making one claim of fact about the subject matter. Its subject is the thing being learned, not the person learning it. When the knowledge is a way of doing something, the sentence states how it is done, never as a command to the reader. It carries the substance supplied by the tasks and answers — shortened, not hollowed — and reads the same without them. Required with stated.

reason.description: Why you cannot tell, in one sentence. Required with unsure.
